description: This Java file defines an Android Activity called ReversingAnimation that demonstrates a custom animation involving bouncing balls. It includes inner classes for managing animation state and drawing the animated objects. The file handles user interactions to start and reverse the animation, and uses Android's animation framework and graphics APIs.

classes.name: ReversingAnimation
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates reversing animation of bouncing balls using ObjectAnimator and custom drawing.

classes.name: ReversingAnimation.MyAnimationView
classes.description: A custom View class that manages the animation of balls, drawing on Canvas, and responds to animation updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and sets up button click listeners to start and reverse the animation.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Initializes the ObjectAnimator for the ball's Y position if not already created.

methods.name: reverseAnimation
methods.description: Reverses the current animation, causing the ball to bounce back.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current play time of the animation for seeking purposes.

methods.name: createBall
methods.description: Creates a drawable ball with random color and gradient, positioned at given coordinates.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Callback method called on each animation frame to invalidate view and trigger redraw.
